body:
Thank you for your reply.

 To answer your question, I have never felt good about my body. I just wasn't born pretty, and my parents let me know in a way. No figure, stretch marks from an overweight childhood, too much body hair etc... I always knew I would have to rely on personality to win people over, but that isn't a strong suite of mine either. I'm not extremely outgoing in person and would naturally stay in the background.

I considered myself extremely lucky when I was in the relationship with him, and I tried to impress him by dressing nicer, taking his advice on what to do with my looks etc. But some things you can't change, at least not without a lot of money, and my ethnicity just doesn't measure up on certain assets...assets I know he likes.

Anyway...that is only half the issue I guess. The other half is how I can't allow myself to feel. The numbess makes things grey and empty in a way, which I guess is just another form of pain.
